raft.k: A secret order born in the Nazi war machine
st: In season 1, HYDRA agents like John Garrett and Grant Ward are exposed inside S.H.I.E.L.D. as the agency falls.
In season 2, Daniel Whitehall's HYDRA hunts an alien Obelisk, until Coulson kills him and S.H.I.E.L.D. picks off its leaders.
In season 3, Ward and Gideon Malick rebuild HYDRA to bring back its ancient master, the Inhuman Hive.
Hive takes over HYDRA's faithful, Talbot's ATCU dismantles the rest, and Hive dies in space.
In season 4, ex-HYDRA agents hired by the Watchdogs ambush Director Mace's team after their Quinjet goes down.
In season 5, General Hale secretly serves HYDRA and raises her daughter Ruby to be its next leader.
Ruby, Strucker and Hale all die, and Hale's HYDRA dies with them.
In season 7, S.H.I.E.L.D. must keep HYDRA's past intact, as the Chronicoms help Freddy Malick push its plans ahead.
In season 1, Project Centipede builds super soldiers from Extremis and stolen science for a hidden master, the Clairvoyant.
Centipede is exposed as a HYDRA project, and it falls when S.H.I.E.L.D. storms Cybertek and Garrett dies.

raft.k: A tech company building cyborg parts
st: In season 1, Cybertek builds Deathlok cyborgs for the Clairvoyant, until S.H.I.E.L.D. storms its facility and finds it tied to HYDRA.
In season 5, S.H.I.E.L.D. learns Cybertek forced scientists to work for HYDRA, and finds its lost ship Principia in the sky.

raft.k: HYDRA in a virtual world where it won
st: In season 4, in the Framework's virtual world, HYDRA rules America under Madame Hydra and hunts Inhumans.
Daisy's team escapes, and when AIDA shuts the Framework down, its HYDRA is erased.
In season 2, the Kree are revealed as the makers of the Inhumans, and the warrior Vin-Tak comes to destroy their Diviners.
In season 3, Hive's beacon calls two Kree Reapers to Earth, and both die there.
In season 5, Kasius's Kree rule the last humans on the Lighthouse in 2091, until Mack kills him and the humans fight back.

raft.k: A secret circle of powerful men at the Arena Club
st: In season 2, the Council of Nine rigs Chadwick's Senate race, until Whitney Frost kills half of it and takes over the rest.

raft.k: An oil company with friends in high places
st: In season 1, a Roxxon scientist turns Howard Stark's stolen formula into nitramene bombs at a Roxxon Oil refinery.
In season 2, Roxxon chief Hugh Jones sits on the Council of Nine, and a Roxxon site stores atomic bombs.

raft.k: The Nazis' science division in Captain Carter's world
st: In season 1, HYDRA fights Captain Carter for the Tesseract, until Red Skull's portal calls a monster that kills him.

raft.k: A Soviet spy school in Captain Carter's world
st: In season 2, Melina's Red Room brainwashes a lost Steve Rogers in the Hydra Stomper and sends its Widows after Carter.
Steve breaks free and flies the Stomper into the Red Room, destroying it.
In season 3, Quentin Beck's Iron Federation of drones rules the survivors of a broken Earth.
Riri drains the nanites out of Beck, killing him and bringing the Federation down.

compound.k: The spy agency Coulson's team serves
st: In season 1, Coulson's team works S.H.I.E.L.D. cases from the Bus, chasing Centipede and a mystery man called the Clairvoyant.
HYDRA rises from inside S.H.I.E.L.D. and the agency falls, and Fury makes Coulson director of what is left.
In season 2, Coulson rebuilds S.H.I.E.L.D. in secret, clashes with a rival 'real S.H.I.E.L.D.', then merges with it.
In season 3, the hidden S.H.I.E.L.D. forms the Secret Warriors, works with the ATCU, and stops Hive's plan for humanity.
Under Director Mace, S.H.I.E.L.D. has Elena sign the Sokovia Accords before she may go after Ramon.
In season 4, Director Mace brings S.H.I.E.L.D. back into the open, until AIDA swaps agents for LMDs and traps others in the Framework.
With Mace dead and its base destroyed, the agents wait to be arrested, until a mysterious group takes them.
In season 5, the agents come back from a ruined 2091 as wanted fugitives, and Daisy stops Talbot from tearing Earth apart.
In season 6, Director Mack rebuilds S.H.I.E.L.D. against Sarge and Izel, while Daisy's team searches space for Fitz.
In season 7, the team chases the Chronicoms through S.H.I.E.L.D.'s past to protect its history, then defeats them.
In season 2, Jiaying's hidden haven of Afterlife guides new Inhumans like Skye through their changes.
Jiaying leads Afterlife into war on S.H.I.E.L.D., and the haven is lost when she and Gordon are killed.
In season 7, in a changed past, Nathaniel Malick seizes Afterlife, kills Gordon for his powers, and kills Jiaying.

compound.k: A US task force that hunts the newly powered
st: In season 3, the ATCU hunts Inhumans and teams up with S.H.I.E.L.D., then, under Talbot, dismantles what is left of HYDRA.

compound.k: The Strategic Scientific Reserve, Peggy Carter's agency
st: In season 2, a 1945 flashback shows Peggy Carter's SSR raiding HYDRA's last base and seizing its relics.
In season 1, the New York SSR hunts Howard Stark as a traitor, then helps Peggy stop Leviathan's gas attack.
In season 2, Sousa's Los Angeles SSR fights Whitney Frost, while the Council of Nine works against it from inside.
In season 2, Isodyne Energy's experiments uncover Zero Matter, until the Council of Nine shuts the program down.

compound.k: Heroes the Watcher gathers from many worlds
st: In season 1, the Watcher gathers heroes from across the multiverse, and they beat Infinity Ultron despite Killmonger's betrayal.
The Watcher sends each of them home, while Strange Supreme stays behind to guard the Infinity Stones.
In season 3, Captain Carter leads Kahhori, Storm and Byrdie in stopping incursions across the multiverse.
Carter gives her life to save the Watcher, and the others join him in watching over the multiverse.

compound.k: The last heroes fighting a zombie plague
st: In season 1, in a world overrun by zombies, Banner, Peter Parker and others reach Camp Lehigh, and a few go on to Wakanda.
Five years on, Kamala, Blade Knight, Yelena and others try to reach space to call for help against the zombies.
Most of them fall in the last battle with Wanda's horde, and Kamala wakes up inside an illusion.
In season 1, Yondu's Ravagers and their Star-Lord, T'Challa, rob the Collector of the Embers of Genesis to end hunger.

compound.k: Xandar's police force, with Nebula in its ranks
st: In season 2, the Nova Corps seals Xandar off from Ronan, and Nebula stops Nova Prime's secret plan to surrender it.

compound.k: Xu Wenwu's army in medieval China
st: In season 2, Wenwu's Ten Rings face the powerless Hela, then fight beside her against Odin and unite with Asgard's armies.

add_steps: In season 3, ex-agent Felix Blake leads the Watchdogs in bombing an ATCU site, a cover for a HYDRA theft.

add_steps: In season 6, a Confederacy cruiser attacks Daisy's ship in deep space, and the Chronicoms take Confederacy ships for their war.
fixes.why: The Confederacy acts again in AoS season 6 ('Missing Pieces', 'The Other Thing'); the file stops at season 5. Append after the season 5 step.
